description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to lease management, including lease acquisition, renewal, and release mechanisms, as well as related data structures and enums within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: AcquiredLease
classes.description: Represents a lease that has been acquired, including resource key, duration, token, and start time.

classes.name: AcquireLeaseResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of an attempt to acquire or renew a lease, including the lease object, status code, and failure exception.

classes.name: ResponseCode
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible response statuses for lease operations such as success, failure, or invalid token.

classes.name: LeaseRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to acquire a lease on a specific resource with a specified duration.

classes.name: ILeaseProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods for batch acquiring, renewing, and releasing leases.

methods.name: AcquiredLease (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AcquiredLease with specified resource key, duration, token, and start time.

methods.name: AcquiredLease (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AcquiredLease with only resource key.

methods.name: AcquireLeaseResult
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of AcquireLeaseResult with given lease, status code, and exception.

methods.name: LeaseRequest
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LeaseRequest with resource key and duration.
